name: Knowify
summary: Bidding, contracts, job costing and invoicing for specialty contractors that bill fixed-price and AIA jobs.
differentiator: Core handles fixed-price and AIA jobs, but subcontracts, cost-plus and time-and-materials contracts and calculated cost templates only start at Advanced ($329 to $399 per month, 10 users). If you do T&M work you start at the higher tier. Extra users are $29 per month on either plan.
pricing: Core is listed at $99 per month on monthly billing and $149 per month on yearly billing (the pricing page shows both figures; confirm which applies), with one user and $29 per extra user. Advanced is $329 to $399 per month with ten users. Enterprise is custom.
whoPays: Subscriber pays per plan plus per extra user
bestFor: Specialty subcontractors on fixed-price and AIA billing.
skipIf: You need cost-plus contracts on a budget.
